The tenth production season of ''[[Futurama]]'' consists of ten episodes. It premiered with all ten episodes on [[Hulu]] in the United States on September 15, 2025. This season also aired back to back episodes weekly on FXX starting September 15, differing to the release strategy of the previous two Hulu seasons.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Shanfeld |first=Ethan |date=August 21, 2025 |title=‘Futurama’ Season 13 Trailer Features Godzilla, an Erupting Volcano and Kissing Siamese Twins |url=https://variety.com/2025/tv/news/futurama-season-13-trailer-1236495241/ |access-date=October 22, 2025 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |language=en-US}}</ref>

This season has alternatively been titled the tenth season (production) and the thirteenth season (broadcast). This list follows the previous season box sets, which feature the episodes in the original, intended production season order, ignoring the order of broadcast.

| ProdCode        = AACV04
| ShortSummary    = Bender's antenna picks up a mysterious [[numbers station]] radio broadcast. Fry, meanwhile, takes up art and starts doing [[paint by number]] paintings. Amy, speculating a connection between the two, converts the numbers broadcast into a paint-by-numbers image, which turns out to be a schematic for a machine that opens a portal into the world of numbers. After exploring this new world, Professor Farnsworth chooses to stay, and soon meets an imprisoned [[Georg Cantor]], who it turns out had sent the broadcast. | ShortSummary    = Having tired of their phone addiction, the Professor, Hermes, and Kif send Cubert, Dwight, Axl, and Bender to a "scared screenless" camp headed by Zapp. While their kids are away, the guys have a guys' night out and the ladies get drunk at a bar. The planet turns out to be inhabited by [[anarcho-primitivist]] hippies, who blame the boys' electronic wizardry for the disappearance of sun during an eclipse. == Production ==
=== Development ===
In November 2023, ''Futurama'' was renewed by Hulu for two more seasons, which will air through 2026.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Rice |first=Lynette |date=November 2, 2023 |title='Futurama' Renewed for Two More Seasons by Hulu |url=https://deadline.com/2023/11/futurama-renewed-two-more-seasons-hulu-1235590020/ |access-date=November 2, 2023 |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]]}}</ref>

== Release ==
The season premiered on September 15, 2025, on Hulu in the United States and on [[Disney+]] internationally on the same day, with two new episodes airing every Monday on [[FXX]] in the United States at 8pm.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Omotade |first=Lade |date=July 22, 2025 |title=‘Futurama’ Season 13 Gets an Unexpected Release Update From Hulu |url=https://collider.com/futurama-season-13-release-date-all-episodes-dropping/ |website=[[Collider (website)|Collider]]}}</ref>

== Reception ==

=== Ratings ===
''Futurama'' premiered on FXX on September 15, 2025. The premiere episode recorded approximately 230,000 viewers (P2+) with a 0.03% rating and 64,000 household viewers (0.05 rating). As of October 14, the program had 60,000 viewers (0.02% rating), reflecting an 18% decrease from the 73,000 viewers reported on October 13, 2025. On October 14, household viewership was 51,500 (0.04 rating), with 13,500 viewers in the 18–49 demographic (0.01 rating) and 25,000 in the 25–54 demographic (0.02 rating). Since its debut, the program's P2+ ratings have ranged between 0.02% and 0.03%, with daily viewership figures between 60,000 and 98,000.<ref>{{Cite web |date=October 14, 2025 |title=Futurama Ratings |url=https://ustvdb.com/networks/fxx/shows/futurama/ |access-date=October 22, 2025 |website=USTVDB |language=en}}</ref> In December 2025, Disney announced that ''Futurama'' was among the television series to surpass one billion hours streamed on Disney+ in 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Giacomazzo |first=Bernadette |date=2025-12-18 |title=Star Wars Day Was the Biggest Streaming Day of 2025 on Di... |url=https://www.complex.com/pop-culture/a/bernadette-giacomazzo/star-wars-day-was-disney-biggest-streaming-day-of-2025 |access-date=2025-12-19 |website=[[Complex Networks]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Lussier |first=Germain |date=2025-12-18 |title='Star Wars' Day Was Disney’s Biggest Streaming Day of the Year |url=https://gizmodo.com/star-wars-day-was-disneys-biggest-streaming-day-of-the-year-2000701092 |access-date=2025-12-19 |website=[[Gizmodo]] |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Artavia |first=David |date=December 18, 2025 |title=Disney’s 2025 Streaming Numbers Are In — ‘Bluey’ Is Still on Top With Over 26M Rewatches |url=https://parade.com/news/disney-2025-streaming-numbers-are-in-bluey-is-still-on-top-with-over-26m-rewatches |access-date=December 19, 2025 |website=[[Parade (magazine)|Parade]]}}</ref>
